writing.modelAnswer:
Dear Chris,
I'm writing to share with you an art class I had in a park last Friday.
Our teacher led us to a quiet corner by the lake and let us paint whatever caught our eye. I chose an old willow tree leaning over the water, with a few ducks swimming beneath it. At first I struggled to mix the green, but after trying again and again, I got the soft colour I wanted. When I added the ripples around the ducks, the whole picture came alive.
Painting outdoors taught me something the classroom never could: I rarely stop to really look at the ordinary things around me. That willow had stood there for years, yet I had walked past it without truly seeing it. How I wish you had been there with me!
Yours,
Li Hua

highlightExpressions.text: At first I struggled to mix the green, but after trying again and again, I got the soft colour I wanted.
highlightExpressions.note: 记叙类应用文的'过程小转折'框架：先点出一处困难，再用 after trying again and again 制造坚持，最后落到结果。把 mix the green / the soft colour 换成任意任务内容（如调试程序、学一道菜、练一个动作），就能让过程有画面、有起伏，避免流水账。

highlightExpressions.text: Painting outdoors taught me something the classroom never could:
highlightExpressions.note: 引出'感想/领悟'的高级框架句，比 I learned a lot 高一档。结构是 'X(这件事) taught me something Y(平时的场景) never could:'，冒号后直接说领悟。换成 This trip / The volunteer work taught me something textbooks never could 即可迁移到任何'分享经历+谈收获'的题。

highlightExpressions.text: That willow had stood there for years, yet I had walked past it without truly seeing it.
highlightExpressions.note: 用过去完成时 + yet 做对比，写'它一直在那儿、我却一直忽略'的反思，让感想从具体事物里长出来而不空泛。框架 'X had been there ..., yet I had ... without ...' 可迁移到任何'习以为常却被重新看见'的领悟。

highlightExpressions.text: How I wish you had been there with me!
highlightExpressions.note: 分享类邮件写给朋友的亲切结尾：wish + 过去完成虚拟语气，表达'真希望你也在'，自然拉近关系、邀请对方共情。换成 How I wish you could have seen it! 等即可用于一切向朋友分享经历的收尾，是得体、够得着的选择性必修级亮点（不堆砌、只用这一处）。
